name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a fascination for organizational psychology and efficiency. After graduating from University College Dublin, he initially worked in the tech sector, optimizing team structures for maximum productivity. However, a lifelong passion for racing, inherited from his father, drew him towards the motorsport world. He saw an opportunity to apply his HR expertise to the fast-paced, high-pressure environment of racing teams.

Joining RFK Racing was a deliberate choice. Liam believed in the team's potential and was drawn to their commitment to innovation. As HR Manager, he focuses on fostering a supportive and collaborative culture, believing that a happy and engaged team is a winning team. His approach emphasizes employee development and creating clear pathways for advancement, ensuring RFK Racing attracts and retains top talent. His knack for identifying potential and nurturing growth is what sets him apart.

Liam's management style is defined by his 'big picture' approach and his ability to inspire his team. He is passionate about continuous improvement and is always looking for ways to enhance processes and create a more efficient and fulfilling workplace for everyone at RFK Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Liam is a man of average height with a thoughtful gaze and a perpetually friendly demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas during meetings, even if they're unrelated to the topic at hand.
Has a standing desk and insists on taking a short walk around the office every hour to clear his head.
Uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversations, often to the amusement (or bewilderment) of his colleagues.
